_note: Sites triaged as acceptable fail-open reads, each with a reason a reader can check against the source -- the same convention as tools/reachability_exemptions.json. Keyed on (file, var) rather than line: line numbers shift on every edit and a stale line silently un-accepts an entry. The cost is that two variables of the same name in one file are accepted together, so check that before adding one. An entry that matches nothing is reported as STALE by the checker rather than ignored: the first entry in this file was resolved within the hour it was written, and nothing would otherwise have said so.
